next_action.description: Build the `paint` step kind. STEP_KINDS (js/components/Organisms/MpiBaseFlow/stepKinds.js) registers box / preview / crop / fields only - its own comment says 'mask, light, mood... as they are built'. Bind through STEP_MEDIA exactly as `crop` does, returning the paint layer as a File (RGBA PNG at photo resolution, the layer ALONE, not the composite), so the FlowDef stays manifest-expressible. Do NOT build a second brush - docs/painting.md owns the RGBA paint layer and the shared brush dab, and docs/masking-undo.md is mandatory reading because any new code mutating a paint layer MUST record an UndoStack entry or it is a silent hole in Ctrl+Z. Read docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/carousel-frame.md and crop-gizmo.md first - crop is the worked example of a kind that returns media rather than a param.

key_decisions: TRAP 1, and it cost the indoor plate its entire composite: ComfyUI's ImageBlend `difference` is `img1 - img2` CLAMPED at 0, NOT abs(). A single call returns an EMPTY mask wherever image2 is brighter, and the flow reads as though the blend simply did nothing (indoor came back changed by 0.18/255). Screen both directions together - one of the pair is zero at every pixel-channel and screen(x,0)==x, so it IS abs().

TRAP 2: session 3's Python thresholds LUMINANCE (convert('L')); a graph can only threshold a CHANNEL. Max-of-three-channels OR'd is strictly more permissive and drags the global re-grade in (sun bg_mean 11.24 vs luminance 10.34, night 6.53 vs 4.52). GREEN alone carries 0.587 of luminance and tracked it to two decimals on every plate - so the signed-off 12/40 thresholds keep meaning what they meant.

TRAP 3: a high threshold does NOT separate shadow from re-grade. The doc's rule says the object and its shadow are a large LOCAL change, but the threshold only encodes 'large'. Klein also makes large changes far from the object - on the sun plate bg_mean plateaus at 8.3 even at threshold 150, so no threshold rejects it. The missing half is LOCAL: intersect strong-change with a 100px dilation of the silhouette. Ungated sun ring 11.09; gated 0.71.

The published ring/fill table in blending-into-a-photo.md is the SILHOUETTE region (compose_back). The settings table names the SHADOW-AWARE region, which was only ever judged BY EYE on shadow quality. Nobody crossed them. Ungated shadow-aware costs 2-3x more movement in the user's untouched photo (sun bg_mean 10.34 vs 3.45). The 100px gate is what makes shadow-aware shippable; drop it to 60 if Fabio wants the photo protected harder, and it is ONE constant.

No median filter in the graph. The only median on the bench is RES4LYF's `Image Median Blur`, which asserts on a float 3-channel image (ksize%2==1 && dims<=2) AND is a custom node the app does not pin. A core ImageBlur before the threshold despeckles the same way.

The blend instruction node is deliberately NOT titled Input_*. The flow HAS a user prompt (Input_Positive, the object), and _buildParams emits Input_Positive on every run - titling the blend text node the same way would silently overwrite the baked BLEND_PHYSICS2 with the user's object prompt.

Klein's relight arm was reduced faithfully, not guessed: all six Input_Lora_* are None, style selector 0, NSFW LoRA strength resolves to 0 for a fixed prompt with no NSFW words, and is_Turbo=True gives steps 4 / cfg 1.0. Node 167 ImageScaleToTotalPixels(1.0MP, /16) is the real cause of the documented 'Klein snaps to /32' dimension change, which is why the tail rescales to base size before compositing.
